freeze: All A1 parameters frozen. Extract pre-z patient_channel_embedding h and final classifier pre-hook input r under model.eval(). No outer loader is built.
absolute_context: For valid channels only: mu=mean(h); sigma=sqrt(mean((h-mu)^2)+1e-5); context=concat(mu,log(sigma+1e-6)). Fit per-dimension mean/std on FIT patients only for each fold and A1 epoch; transform (context-fit_mean)/(fit_std+1e-6) for fit and validation.

variants.P0: Frozen A1 NEZ-positive logits; no probe
variants.P1: Residual head input concat(r, zeros_like(normalized absolute context))
variants.P2: Same residual head input concat(r, normalized absolute context)

residual_head: Linear(input_dim,32)-GELU-Dropout(0.10)-Linear(32,1); final Linear weight and bias exactly zero; delta=0.5*tanh(raw_delta); final NEZ logit=A1 logit+delta. P1/P2 identical parameter count and initialization.

probe_training.loss: A1 patient-equal weighted BCEWithLogits; EZ weight 2, NEZ weight 1, normalize per patient then mean over patients
probe_training.checkpoint: Final probe epoch 15 only; no probe-epoch validation selection
probe_training.patient_batch: Full FIT-patient batch, one optimizer step per epoch; canonical patient-ID order, no shuffle. P1/P2 use identical order and initial state.
probe_training.matched_pair_rng: Initialize each fold/base-epoch pair with torch manual seed 42+1000*fold+epoch, copy the same initialized head to P1/P2, reset the same RNG state before each matched probe train.

validation_selection: Original A1 VLOO: for each excluded patient, other 12 choose A1 base epoch 1..30 and NEZ probability threshold float32 linspace(0.05,0.95,19), tie break Macro-F1, EZ-F1, BA, closest threshold to .5, earlier A1 epoch. Fullval separately selects on all 13 and is apparent only.

residual_diagnostic.saturation_near_pm0_5: fraction abs(delta) >= 0.49 on VLOO-selected validation predictions
residual_diagnostic.pair_order_change: fraction of valid unordered channel pairs whose NEZ-logit sign ordering changes after residual

terminal_rule: Use ABSOLUTE_CONTEXT_COMPLEMENTARITY_SUPPORTED only if full test-readiness gate passes. Else use RESIDUAL_CAPACITY_ONLY_SUPPORTED if P1-P0 and P2-P0 mean VLOO Macro-F1 are each >=0.010 but P2-P1 <0.005. Otherwise use ABSOLUTE_CONTEXT_COMPLEMENTARITY_NOT_SUPPORTED. Source reproduction failure has priority.
outer_policy: Development only. Do not read outer-test labels, predictions, metrics, or results. A passing gate freezes a finding only; no outer test or end-to-end retraining.
public_data_policy: Commit only aggregate CSV/JSON/Markdown and code/lock. Keep patient IDs, channels, embeddings, logits, labels, checkpoints, private paths and runtime logs outside Git.
